cases.sentence: Когда приближался ___ Шалашей , 3 братья Иисуса сказали Ему:
cases.explain: «иудейский праздник» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

cases.sentence: ___ праздника уже прошла, когда Иисус пришел в храм и стал учить.
cases.explain: «Первая половина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

cases.sentence: В последний и самый ___ праздника Иисус встал и громко возгласил:
cases.explain: «торжественный день» — after the preposition «в», the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

cases.sentence: Кто верит в Меня, как говорит Писание, у того из сердца потекут реки ___.
cases.explain: «живой воды» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
